title: Prime London property prices fall up to 25% from peak
summary:
Property prices in prime central London areas have declined significantly, with some neighbourhoods experiencing drops of more than 25% from their previous peaks. Inner London boroughs recorded an 8.3% price decrease in the year to June, whilst Westminster saw the steepest decline at 25.4% year-on-year.

title: Lender completes £755,000 hotel refinance in under a month
summary:
A bridging finance lender has completed a £755,000 refinance on an 18-bedroom hotel in Somerset less than a month after joining a lending platform. The case progressed rapidly after the lender agreed to work from an existing specialist hotel valuation.

title: City office secures £47.2m refurbishment finance
summary:
A 58,000 sq ft office building in the City of London has secured £47.2 million in refurbishment finance from a specialist debt fund. The facility refinances the owner's acquisition bridge loan and funds works including a full internal refurbishment and additional top floor targeting BREEAM Excellent certification.

title: Historic tower conversions listed across UK market
summary:
Five properties in converted or purpose-built towers have been listed for sale across England and Scotland, ranging from £268,000 to £1.1 million. The listings include a converted A-listed country house in Edinburgh, apartments in Newcastle and London tower blocks, and a former Cornish engine house.

title: UK house price growth slows to 0.8% in September
summary:
Annual house price growth in the UK halved to 0.8% in September, marking the weakest rate of expansion since December 2025, according to Nationwide. Average house prices declined 0.2% monthly to £274,251, with regional variations showing Northern Ireland leading at 5.9% annual growth whilst East Anglia posted a 0.7% decline.

title: UK mortgage rates reach two-year high amid inflation concerns
summary:
Mortgage rates across the UK have climbed to two-year highs, with major lenders withdrawing products priced below 5% as economic pressures intensify. Barclays, Nationwide, Virgin Money and TSB have all announced rate increases amid rising inflation.

title: House price to earnings ratio falls to lowest since 2015
summary:
The house price to earnings ratio in Britain has fallen to 7.3, its lowest level since 2015, according to research by Lloyds. Average property prices increased by 0.5% to £299,131 while average earnings rose by 4.5% to £40,790, though higher mortgage rates have offset some affordability gains.

title: Cynergy Bank finances £32m South London retail portfolio
summary:
Real estate finance specialist SHC Capital has arranged an investment term loan from Cynergy Bank for a property investment group, secured against a multi-asset high street retail portfolio in South London valued at £32 million. The group plans to refurbish retail units in the portfolio, which are fully tenanted and generating income.

title: Bridging lender completes £490,000 auction finance in four days
summary:
Bridging lender WSP Capital has completed £490,000 of auction finance at 75% loan-to-value within four days of issuing its formal offer. The transaction was arranged after the borrower's original lender withdrew shortly before the completion deadline.
